title: Superclass constructor runs before subclass construction
answer: When constructing an object of a subclass, Java initializes the superclass portion first. The subclass constructor begins by invoking a superclass constructor, explicitly with `super(...)` or implicitly with `super()` when legal. Only after superclass construction returns does the remaining subclass constructor body execute. In AeroTopo, creating an `Orthomosaic` invokes `Product(String,List)` before validating and assigning the `gsd` field.
